objective: Auditar por que la sincronizacion automatica comercial/ISCAM no esta manteniendo actualizado el detalle para SoftRestaurant y ManagementPro. Revisar ultimas ejecuciones de sync_comercial_v2 y logs de conectividad/sync sin modificar datos ni codigo.

queries.name: scheduler_comercial_v2_recent_runs
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 60 JobName,RunID,Accion,FechaAccion,Exito,MensajeError,DetallesJSON FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' ORDER BY FechaAccion DESC

queries.name: scheduler_commercial_related_recent_runs
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 JobName,RunID,Accion,FechaAccion,Exito,MensajeError FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName LIKE '%comercial%' OR JobName LIKE '%ISCAM%' ORDER BY FechaAccion DESC

queries.name: sync_log_schema
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Comercial_SyncLog_v2' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: sync_log_recent
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 50 * FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 ORDER BY created_at DESC

queries.name: unit_catalog_current
queries.sql: SELECT u.codigo,u.nombre,u.activo AS unidad_activa,u.server_id,u.sucursal_origen_id,s.system_type,s.activo AS servidor_activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u LEFT JOIN dbo.Servidores_Conexiones s ON s.id=u.server_id WHERE u.codigo IN ('ESTELAR','CIENFUEGOS','130MID','ORIGEN','130QRO') ORDER BY u.codigo
